schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file was written for

agent_port.description: Port of the agent endpoint, the one hub destination open to instances (/mcp and /v1)

operator_bind.description: Address the operator channel listens on: an address that is neither a wildcard nor one of the instance pool, or "core", the address of the hub outside the instance networks (the one its port is published on) and its own loopback (ADR 0025)

main_agent_bind.description: Address the main-agent endpoint listens on; the same forms as hub.operator_bind

egress_port.description: Port of the egress proxy, the second hub destination open to a regulated instance: it relays a connection to an allowed host and logs every destination asked for (ADR 0024)

data_dir.description: Directory of the state of the hub; mounted in no execution context

filter_socket.description: Unix socket of the container filter

operator_token_file.description: File that holds the operator token, readable by the operating-system user of the human only

main_agent_token_file.description: File that holds the main-agent token

control_socket.description: Unix socket, open to the user of the hub only, on which `zephyros hub rotate-token` asks the running hub for a new operator or main-agent token (ADR 0026)

core_network.description: Network of the hub and the filter

hub_container.description: Name of the hub container, which the filter attaches to each instance network

guard_health_seconds.description: How long the hub waits for a network guard to report healthy; after that the instance does not start

poll_seconds.description: How often the hub looks at its instances: a turn that ended or ran too long, a guard that stopped

instance.description: Image of an agent container, by digest

guard.description: Image of the network guard, by digest

opencode.description: Image of an instance that runs OpenCode (images/instance-opencode), by digest; required when an instance runs OpenCode

instance_pool.description: Range the subnets of the instance networks are taken from; it overlaps no network of the user

instance_prefix.description: Prefix length of the subnet of one instance network

resolvers.description: Name resolvers an open instance uses (a regulated or sealed one sends no query; the egress proxy resolves for it); an address of a protected network is refused, because the network guard blocks it

egress.description: What an instance reaches besides the hub (ADR 0024): regulated, the allowed hosts through the egress proxy of the hub; sealed, nothing else; open, every public destination. No level reaches a protected network

allowed_hosts.description: Host names a regulated instance reaches on port 443 through the egress proxy; a name, never an address or a wildcard

engine.description: The agent engine of the Contractor instance (ADR 0029): hermes, or opencode, a third-party coding agent, in the image images.opencode. The hub's guarantees do not depend on it: the same guard, sandbox, gate, rights and model gateway. The Owner instance runs Hermes

contractor.description: The Contractor instance of each project

instances.description: The agent engine of each side of a project

memory_mib.description: Memory of an agent container, in MiB (a real turn of the second real run reached 1019 MiB)

pids.description: Processes and threads of an agent container

guard_memory_mib.description: Memory of a network guard, in MiB

silence_seconds.description: A turn that has called the hub, the model included, none of the time for this long is stopped

refusals_per_minute.description: Refused actions of one instance in a minute before the hub answers without doing the work (ATK-71)

limits.description: Limits of the containers and of a turn

lifetime_seconds.description: Lifetime of the token of a turn; the hub renews it while the turn runs

rotate_before_seconds.description: The hub renews the token of a running turn when less than this remains of its lifetime (four rounds of the watchdog at least)

channel_lifetime_days.description: Lifetime of the operator token and of the main-agent token; a token issued before this key existed gets it from the next start of the hub (ADR 0026)

provider.description: Model provider behind the gateway: the obedient stub, or an OpenAI-compatible service

upstream_url.description: Base URL of the provider, when it is openai-compatible

credential_file.description: File that holds the model credential, when the provider is openai-compatible

model.description: Name of the model instances ask for

upstream_model.description: Name of the model at the provider, when it differs from the one instances ask for

models.description: The models the gateway may serve at the provider, when it is openai-compatible: the model it sends (gateway.upstream_model, or gateway.model when that is unset) must be one of them, and the hub refuses to start for any other. This list is the model policy of the hub: naming one model authorises that one alone

session_header.description: Name of the session header the gateway sends to the provider, when it asks for one (OpenCode Go requires x-opencode-session); unset sends none. The value is one stable session name per hub process

reasoning_echo.description: Send the reasoning of the model back to the provider with the conversation, on every assistant message, when it is openai-compatible: a thinking model such as DeepSeek refuses a conversation without it, a strict provider one with it. Unset, it is true when the model at the provider (its name holds deepseek, kimi or mimo) or its host is of a family that asks for it (DeepSeek, Kimi, MiMo), false otherwise (ADR 0032)

context_window.description: The context window of the model the gateway serves, in tokens, as its provider gives it: the agents work with all of it unless gateway.context_tokens says less, and compact early enough that the provider never refuses a call for its length (ADR 0033)

context_tokens.description: The context the agents work with, in tokens, when less than the window of the model: for a model of a million tokens, 400 000 or 256 000. Below 256000 it is accepted with a warning at every start and in every evidence report. Unset, the whole window

timeout_seconds.description: How long the gateway waits for one answer of the provider, in seconds, when it is openai-compatible: a long answer of a real model takes minutes

simulation.description: Run with the simulated provider and mark the report, the pull request and the events as a simulation (EXG-46)

provider.description: Where pull requests are opened: none, the forge in a directory (bare git repositories, for the development deployment and the tests), or GitHub (the repositories of the person, through its API and git over https)

root.description: Directory of the forge, when the provider is directory

token_file.description: File of the token GitHub is called with, when the provider is github; read at each call, never copied and never written down

runner.description: What runs the acceptance tests: none (every verification ends in an error), or a sandbox created through the container filter

kit.description: The verification kit of the projects

kit_image.description: The image of that kit, by digest, when the runner is sandbox

timeout_seconds.description: Longest run of the acceptance tests of one delivery; the delivery loop runs one verification at a time, so a long one makes the next deliveries wait

protected_paths.description: Paths of the client's own files (a path, or a directory ending with /): a delivery that changes one is flagged in its report and its pull request, never refused

source.description: The tools of the projects (ADR 0030): a directory of the machine, as the container runtime sees it, mounted read-only at /opt/project-tools in every turn, Owner and Contractor, and in every sandbox of verification. The hub reads it at the same path, refuses to start when the user of the instances could change it or a link leads out of it, and writes its fingerprint to the log and to the evidence report

tools.description: The tools of the projects, mounted read-only

url.description: Where the hub posts its signed notifications; empty turns them off

secret.description: Shared secret the receiver verifies the signatures with (EXG-43); at least 16 characters when a url is set

notifications.description: Signed notifications to the main agent

inactivity_seconds.description: A task without activity for this long: wake the instance, then restart it (US-E7-01)

restarts.description: How many restarts before the main agent is alerted

unblock_seconds.description: How long the main agent has to unblock a task before the human is alerted

rejections.description: FAIL decisions in a row on one project before the main agent is alerted (EXG-23)

continuity.description: The escalation ladder of a task without activity

title: Zephyros configuration
x-zephyros-rules: hub.agent_port, hub.operator_port, hub.main_agent_port and hub.egress_port are four different ports
network.instance_prefix is longer than the prefix of network.instance_pool
hub.operator_bind and hub.main_agent_bind are not addresses of network.instance_pool
network.resolvers holds no address of a protected network (the guard blocks them)
forge.token_file is set when forge.provider is github

gateway.upstream_url and gateway.credential_file are set when gateway.provider is openai-compatible, and the model it sends to the provider (gateway.upstream_model, or gateway.model when that is unset) is one of gateway.models
verification.kit_image is set when verification.runner is sandbox
images.opencode is set when instances.contractor.engine is opencode
gateway.simulation runs only with the stub provider
notifications.url and notifications.secret are set together, the url is http(s), and the secret is at least 16 characters
